name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on a single P150a
description: A tt-model bundle that serves Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (hybrid Gated DeltaNet plus full attention, 256-expert MoE) on one Blackhole P150a through vLLM, with a 262K context, bf4 experts and bf8 paged KV. Multi-turn prefix reuse across up to four conversation slots holds time-to-first-token near 0.3 s as a chat grows. The card reports about 37 tok/s decode and 600-880 tok/s prefill, and its code/ directory is byte-identical to the model code in the container image.
author: Adartras
